description: Read-only diagnostics of saved five-XGB and equal five-seed CNN historical validation predictions and their fixed 80/20 blend. No models trained, no submission weights tuned, no submissions written. Years are development validation, not untouched tests.

2021.near_switch_definition: Within +/- 2 hours of a truth-label transition; t0 has no preceding truth label. Diagnostic only; truth-based partition cannot serve as an input.

label_oracle.warning: Leaky per-output oracle sees each validation truth label and chooses max score for positives or min score for negatives; unattainable diagnostic ceiling, not a deployable model.

validation_generator_selection.warning: Leaky descriptive choice of best within-generator AUC among XGB/CNN/blend on this same validation year. Not OOF, not an unbiased score, and not necessarily an upper bound on micro AUC because scales cross generators.
